text:
alexa: FYI - customer reported duplicated toolcall after a truncated stream + client retry. ledger shows provisional + final both charged. anyone seen this pattern?
jamal: can you paste the minimal repro?
alexa: steps: client streamed -> received FIN at token ~1200 (server truncated) -> client retried immediately -> router sent to fallback shard -> toolcall executed a second time. billing ledger has both entries.
kevin: do we preserve session id across reconnect? if not, dedupe will miss.
alexa: client kept X-Session: reed-7b-973, but router changed shards on reconnect. dedupe cache is local to shard so second execution occurred.
rachel: right now routing affinity keys on (session, shard). reconnect-to-different-shard loses local dedupe.
billing-bot: INFO billing: provisional_charge(session=reed-7b-973, tokens=1200, id=pc_9e8)
billing-bot: INFO billing: confirmed_charge(session=reed-7b-973, tokens=1189, id=cc_ab3)
alexa: console shows both as charges (no refund flag) so users see a double bill.
kevin: short-term UI mitigation: mark provisional entries visually as provisional and add hover copy: "may be reconciled; refunds possible". long-term: two options: global dedupe index or sticky route-on-reconnect window.
jamal: global index costs us cross-shard consistency and latency. prefer routing affinity approach: try original shard for N seconds.
rachel: proposal: router includes X-Prev-Shard header on reconnects; recipient shard checks local dedupe cache and can short-circuit toolcall if duplicate. If miss, fallback to normal logic.
alexa: plus we need telemetry: track provisional->confirmed delta per shard and per route change.
devex: UI mock idea: add "provisional" badge next to ledger rows, clickable link "open refund" which creates ops ticket with session and trace.
kevin: implementation plan: 1) router change to emit X-Prev-Shard when client reconnects (PR). 2) shard: on incoming request with X-Prev-Shard, consult local dedupe cache keyed by session+toolcall-hash. if hit, return deduped response; if miss, proceed. 3) add lightweight async global index for rare misses as fallback (deprioritized). 4) console: provisional badge + refund flow.
jamal: I'll file infra ticket to scope router change and shard cache extension. tagging @billing for ledger semantics.
alexa: created INC-7421 with logs + stack traces. requesting P2. customer impact but workaround exists.
rachel: P2 works. I'll draft support runbook: how to identify double provisional in console and escalate.
kevin: also add metric: provisional_count - confirmed_count by route/shard and alert if above threshold. helps measure progress after change.
alexa: good call. also add e2e test: simulate truncated stream + immediate reconnect to different shard to assert no double charge after change.
devex: will draft the console copy and the refund ticket flow.
alexa: thanks all.
kevin: one gotcha: session affinity window needs to balance availability vs dedupe correctness. propose 30s sticky window by default, tunable per customer.
jamal: note: need to coordinate with regional failover policies so we don't block recovery during outages.
alexa: noted. will add to ticket. :eyes:
